review_scope: All 125 manuscripts inventoried; chapter order, section coverage and rendered body completeness checked against the 25 Chinese chapter structures.
Targeted manual review of delivery notes and high-risk argument/scene passages across five languages. This is not exhaustive native-speaker proofreading or a complete audiovisual rewatch.

Existing simplified/traditional Chinese and English article prose remains unchanged. Thirty root HTML pages change only their selector and marked head metadata; thirty Traditional Chinese assets remain byte-identical.

Source ZIPs and received Markdown remain immutable. Exact editorial replacements are recorded separately. Anime hub synopsis was minimally aligned with Konatsu's eventual admission, including its Traditional Chinese mapping.
editorial_decisions: Rakugo: retain delivered Konatsu admission, Matsuda narration and separate collapse/fire corrections. Distinguish recordings from live transmission; qualify exclusive memory access and retrospective time intervals; limit the no-explanation claim to the performance rather than the later hospital conversation.

Gundam: retain separation of original TV narrative from The Origin and later chronology; do not erase the moral reason for Ramba Ral's refusal or Miharu's effect on Kai. Remove reversed explicit revenge/duel ordering; replace overprecise three-billion callbacks with billions consistently.
From the New World: retain corrected voluntary sacrifice and imprisonment actor. Remove unverified Go-rule analogy while keeping human supervision and classification argument.
Macross: retain Pluto-orbit correction and distinction between engineered exclusions and later personal deprivation. Do not equate the life-loss statistic with an identical population-loss statistic.

Utena: retain Wakaba-letter duel trigger and corrected childhood/episode scope. Distinguish outward compliance from absence of pain; label Akio's measure of success as his measure. Preserve failed rescue without asserting a never-touching-hands or particular falling-person shot; synchronize callbacks.
Presentation: fold edition notices consistently, keep prose rather than boilerplate in snippets, finish snippets at sentence/word boundaries, allow long German titles to wrap on mobile.

remaining_uncertainties: Rakugo Matsuda/shinigami joke attribution remains supplied rather than independently frame-verified; no literal supernatural conclusion is independently established by this review.

From the New World ending mechanics are supplied corrected copy; no frame-by-frame independent rewatch. Chromosome count functions as a fictional narrative clue, not a claim about real-world proof of species identity.
Macross detailed loss estimates come from later setting material as labeled, not a newly verified primary census; plot dialogue remains paraphrase, not official subtitles.
Utena confession chronology, glasses placement and precise ending shots remain follow-up items; rescue text no longer depends on the disputed falling-person or no-contact assertions.
Preserved Chinese/English originals still contain some of the source issues discussed in delivery notes; this batch does not silently rewrite them.
